name_in_paper: surface staining PBMC for chemokine receptors

evidence.quote: To assess the effect of vaccination route on cell trafficking we measured the expression of chemokine receptors by surface staining PBMC for 30 min at 37 °C with CCR4/PERCPCY5.5, CCR6/AF647 (Biolegend), CCR7/PECY7 and CXCR3/PECY5 (BD Bioscience)
Anti-r85A IgG was measured in serum samples collected at week 0, 2, 4 and 24.

name_in_paper: serological testing for hepatitis B, hepatitis C and HIV

evidence.quote: Enrolled subjects were in good health, had normal baseline haematology and biochemistry, and negative serological testing for hepatitis B, hepatitis C and HIV.

name_in_paper: routine laboratory biochemical and haematological parameters
